notes.title: Soundtrack Available Now!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that our soundtrack is now available for free on Steam! Thanks to our audio team and our musicians for this wonderful work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41889819/4affe717952d28fec55326f479b6ce23158d1a04.png[/img]

notes.title: Audio Hotfix - Release 1.2.3
notes.content:
[b]Changelist[/b]

- Updated the mix based on player feedback
- Fixed a bug where the gameplay music became dramatically quieter while being chased
- Fixed a bug where the end credits, menu, and cinematic music varied dramatically in volume
from one player to the next.
- Fixed a bug where specific music wouldn't loop correctly
- Fixed a bug where specific dialogue cues were not properly triggering
- Fixed a bug where reverb tails were interfering with dialogue triggers

notes.title: Now available on Steam
notes.content:
After many weeks of work, we are proud to announce that Shadow Burglar is officially on Steam. Your quest can begin! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41889819/59b1dff8e99338369f7c441419220ae652b97a86.png[/img]

notes.title: Shadow Burglar is releasing soon
notes.content:
Shadow Burglar will soon be released on Steam. For several weeks, we worked very hard to bring you the best product that we could. As a group of video game students, we are very happy to finally show you the result. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41889819/434c90b73950364720db9e1f899f1e3cd48e8eb4.png[/img]
